ipv6-subnet-calculator.name: IPv6 Subnet Calculator
ipv6-subnet-calculator.description: Calculate IPv6 CIDR network ranges, exact address counts and normalized addresses locally.

meta.title: IPv6 Subnet Calculator
meta.description: Calculate IPv6 CIDR network ranges, exact address counts and normalized addresses locally.
meta.keywords: IPv6 Subnet Calculator, IPv6, CIDR, RFC 5952

ipv6Subnet.emptyResult: Enter an IPv6 address with a prefix to calculate its subnet.
ipv6Subnet.hint: Use an IPv6 address with /0–/128 (no leading zeros in the prefix). Compressed addresses and dotted IPv4 tails are accepted; brackets, ports and zone IDs are not. Maximum {limit} characters.
ipv6Subnet.rules: IPv6 has no broadcast address. The count includes every address in the range, without subtracting reserved addresses or predicting usable hosts. Dotted IPv4 tails are displayed in hexadecimal; the offset is zero-based.
ipv6Subnet.required: Enter an IPv6 address and prefix.
ipv6Subnet.invalidCidr: Use address/prefix with exactly one slash.
ipv6Subnet.invalidAddress: Invalid IPv6 address. Check the groups and double-colon compression.
ipv6Subnet.invalidPrefix: Prefix must be an integer from 0 to 128 without leading zeros.
